Name: MOVEMENT_ENEMY_TYPE_PARAM_ST
Description: Movement settings for enemy types: speeds, accelerations and brakes for boosting, jumping, Quick Boosts, landing, flying and tank movement. Speeds are in km/h and accelerations in m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved package export flag.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved package export flag.
